in_marathi.name: Shahabaz
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the World
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shahabaz हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shahabaz is derived from Persian and Arabic origins. It is composed of two words: Shah, meaning king or lord, and Bahaz, meaning world. The name thus translates to 'Lord of the World' or 'Ruler of the Universe'.
